{{Quote|Been told you need a good ship. Well, I don't have a good ship. I have a great ship!|Jerwo Vhob|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Jerwo Vhob''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] residing on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Rishi]] in [[3637 BBY]], Vhob flew a group of independent operatives to [[Razorback Island]], where the [[Order of Revan]] had set up a [[Jammer|signal jammer]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jerwo Vhob appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', a [[2014]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as the starting NPC for the Battle of Rishi Flashpoint.<ref name="TOR" />
